name: [😀HALLOWEEN PT 2] Grand Piece Online
desc:
Set out on a journey on the vast sea in seek of wealth, fame, and power! Gain experience through quests, discover various fighting styles, and find ability-granting fruits to become stronger! Compete with other players through arena modes and battle royale!🏴‍☠️✨

Current max level: 675

Current fruits:
Common - Suke, Kilo, Spin, Heal
Rare - Bari, Mero, Horo, Gomu, Bomu
Epic - Yomi, Spring, Kira
Legendary - Mera, Pika, Hie, Magu, Goro, Gura, Zushi, Suna, Ito, Paw, Yuki, Kage, Yami, Goru, Smoke, and Biscuit
Mythical - Tori, Mochi, Ope, Venom, Buddha, Pteranodon, Dragon, Soul, and Leopard

Fruits are found through natural spawns under trees, fishing, fruit chests, dungeons, and much more! 

2x Legendary/Mythical Fruit rates,2x Boss drop rates and 1.25x EXP boost every Friday-Sunday! 🍀🔥

Premium players earn bonus XP in the battle royale battlepass, extra rewards in the AFK world, and reduce natural fruit spawn timers!💎

🎮 Controller, 💻 PC, 📱 Mobile Support
